summary.text: Three Breaths Future Vision is a time path investigative immortal killer move from Hei Fan true inheritance. Using after Immortal Gu as the core, it lets the Gu Immortal see their future situation within three breaths.

claims.text: At Tai Qiu, as Fang Yuan is about to chase a fallen ancient eagle hound, a scene of the future flashes in his eyes: a third ancient eagle hound ambushes him, claws him to the ground, fractures his bones, and breaks bloodstained conqueror’s robe. He trusts the image because it is the result of this pre-activated immortal killer move. Knowing the ambush, he shoots sword marks targeting death at the hidden third ancient eagle hound instead of charging down.

In Crazed Demon Cave an unidentified voice tells Fang Yuan not to waste effort on the desolate beast corpses. Life forms there have no value, and the corpses cannot be sold in treasure yellow heaven because the dao marks in their bodies are completely chaotic. He is shocked. He has been using the move, but it can only let him see events related to himself three breaths later. ‘See’ was not ‘hear’. The move has its flaws. He cannot foresee voices. Soon he sees the future: a white robed Gu Immortal with a middle aged appearance comes out of nowhere, behind him and toward his right, about ten steps away. Three breaths later the white robed Gu Immortal appears at that spot. Fang Yuan turns. The immortal smiles and tells him not to be afraid, naming himself Not Immortal.

Hei Lou Lan’s fire ray immortal killer move comes concealed by a large earth path hand and is astonishingly fast, but Fang Yuan avoids it easily by lightly moving his dragon body. The move behind the dodge is three breaths future vision, which Hei Lou Lan does not know Fang Yuan has.
When Lu Wei Yin appears, the move has already been active but does not warn Fang Yuan. He judges it too low ranked. The core time path Immortal Gu After is only rank seven.

On Heavenly Court’s battlefield, a scene flashes in Fang Yuan’s mind before it happens: Duke Long appearing on the right of Myriad Year Flying Warship, World Shaking Dragon Hammer sending the warship flying, and Cang Xuan Zi’s space path traps cutting the surrounding space. With Fang Yuan’s dao mark amplification the move’s power has increased by fifteen hundred times, so it can show effect even when battling an expert at Duke Long’s level. It is essentially only rank seven, so it does not show effect every time. It succeeds sometimes and fails at other times. Duke Long then appears on the right of the warship, just like the scene the move displayed, and Fang Yuan steers the warship away from the traps.
